name: bubbler_one
description: Bubbler One is an original font with thin strokes that are particularly straight. It is a legible typeface in small sizes. You can use Bubbler One for any kind of text, formal or informal, big or small; I hope you find it useful! Designed by Brenda Gallo and Gustavo Dipre .
